title: Woman Thinks Police Can't Arrest Her Because She Has Anxiety
description:
On December 13th, 2022, an officer on patrol noticed a vehicle breaking multiple traffic regulations. He followed the car, which was swerving throughout, until it stopped in a curb lane. Upon approaching the driver, he could clearly smell the odor of alcohol emanating from the driver. While he headed to his police unit to check the credibility of the female's documents, another officer arrived and made contact with her. Right when the officer finished explaining the second test to the female, she attempted to get inside the car and drive off. The female continued to panic and asked the officers to call her parents. As she was being transported to jail, she persisted in crying. Shortly after, the female's mother arrived and was briefed about the incident by the officer. The female was charged with DUI, resisting arrest and obedience to traffic control.
